Cards.emptyCards: This deck has no cards yet.
Cards.note: The status column shows your own progress. Only you add, edit and delete the cards.
Changes.note: “Oluştur” opens a new deck; it starts private, you alone see it and you alone read its tags. “Kart ekle”, “Düzenle” and “İçe aktar” from a file change the deck’s cards; if a row of the file is invalid, no card is added. If the deck is published, or is a course’s or a köşk’s deck, every card change reaches everyone who reads it at once, without a new review. “Kartı sil” deletes the card for good; it cannot be undone. “Dışa aktar” changes nothing.
Create.noticeText: Other members cannot see it. To open it to everyone, ask for it to be published from the deck page; Medaris staff review it and publish it if it fits.
Create.subtitle: Gather your memorisation cards in a deck. You add the cards after the deck is created.
Create.tagsHelp: Optional. Separate with commas; only you see your tags.
Create.title: Create a deck
Create.tryAgainKept: Something went wrong; what you wrote was kept. Try again.
